verdict.rationale: The API exposes the same independent index that powers Brave Search [31]. It covers the search surfaces a UI user would expect: web, image, video, news and local/POI search, plus rich vertical results, suggestions, spell check, AI summaries and answers. It also supports the same query controls, including search operators, date and country filters, safesearch, Goggles re-ranking and pagination. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement of UI/API parity, no evidence that account and dashboard functions (API key creation, plan and billing management) are available via the API, and no published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404) or independent corroboration.
